name: Frost
author: Erin Carter
description: A cluster of frosted-glass forms drifting and merging — raymarched 3D glass that refracts and reflects a soft palette-tinted environment, its surface scattering light into a milky translucence with a broad satin sheen. Reads as real rendered glass filling the frame.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: How fast the glass forms drift and merge; 0 holds them still.

params.label: Merge
params.effect: Softness of the welds where forms meet; high fuses them into smooth glass bridges.

params.label: Frost
params.effect: Surface roughness — from clear polished glass at 0 to a milky scattering frost at 1.

params.label: Spread
params.effect: How far the forms roam from the centre; low packs a tight knot, high scatters them.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera; 0 ignores the mouse.
